notes.title: REMEDIUM Act II Update is Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/efb72778f6fc61cc3a8052045d5b994c87a828c6.jpg
Happy Holidays, Survivors!

We’re excited to announce a new update for Act II of REMEDIUM! Our team has been hard at work to enhance your gameplay experience and address your feedback. 

Here’s what’s new:

 We’ve visually improved the Fort and its surrounding areas for a more immersive atmosphere.
 Barriers have been added to the Fort and nearby locations to refine navigation.
 Fixed map gaps where players could fall and get stuck.
 Additional resources are now scattered throughout locations to aid your journey.
 The Harpy's lock-picking mechanic in the village fountain has been revamped.
 Final cutscene animations for Act II have been polished for a smoother viewing experience.
 Notes have been added to enrich the storytelling and lore.
 Transitions between locations are now seamless and consistent.
 Fire rings have been added to the Statue Boss to make the battle even more thrilling!

Moreover REMEDIUM is part of the ESDigital Games Winter Sale on Steam from December 19 to January 2! Get ready to dive into this intense twin-stick shooter at a special discount!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/a4f9d1ef8730ad994970480d5523d87424ac24a5.jpg

Plus, REMEDIUM is included in the epic Say Hello to Our Hits Bundle, alongside AWAKEN - Astral Blade, Cats on Duty, Unusual Findings, and 9 Monkeys of Shaolin.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48524/Say_hello_to_our_Hits_Bundle/

Thank you to everyone who purchased REMEDIUM for your continued support and feedback! Let us know what you think about the game by writing a review here on Steam, posting it in the Discussions, or chat with us on the official ESDigital social media accounts. We'll keep working to improve this game and provide you with a better game experience and new content in near future! And happy holidays!

notes.title: Full Act 2 Update for REMEDIUM Out Today!
notes.notes:
Fantastic news everyone! We have today released a new content update for REMEDIUM via Steam Early Access! This thrilling new update completes the highly anticipated Act 2 of the game and packs in a wealth of new content to expand the world of REMEDIUM.  

The new complete Act 2 update introduces two new locations—the Fort and Abbey—to the previously released Mine location. These locations contain a host of terrifying enemies and boss types for players to discover and engage in frantic twin-stick shooter action. You will also dive deeper into the storyline with the newly added intro cutscene, providing an engaging introduction to the world of REMEDIUM. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/

The Act 2 content update will also introduce new quality-of-life improvements, many of which were requested by the community already playing the Steam Early Access release. Some of these quality-of-life improvements include an updated and optimized transitioning system to seamlessly travel between game locations, a new upgrade to the save system so players can replay Act 1 or Act 2 (after starting it for the first time) at any time with their progress saved and with any weapons and upgrades already unlocked, additional balancing of battles to ensure a smooth combat experience, numerous UI and UX improvements and bug fixes and the engaging intro cutscene to set the scene of the carnage of Act 2 perfectly!

[previewyoutube=2Tq5Qhs72Yo;full][/previewyoutube]

Following directly on from the devastating boss battle at the end of Act 1, REMEDIUM Act 2 opens a new chapter in the hunt for a cure to the Grey Plague and to your very survival in the world ravaged by hordes of mutants and chimeras. Armed only with their journal, players must navigate the snowy mountain paths and survive the onslaught of warring tribes of mutants spread across three village locations. In each new location, the blood thirsty mutants are protected by a terrifying and unique boss, who must be defeated in order to unveil the path to the cure for the disease and the survival of the remaining humans. 

REMEDIUM Act 2 features:

 Act 2 introduces three new locations with unique mutant types and terrifying bosses.
 Discover the new Fort and Abbey locations as well as the Mines. 
 Continuation of the intriguing storyline of the hero’s deadly journey.  
 Players can craft new parts for their weapons (to further customise them and deal different types of damage) with the new reagents found in Act 2.
 Updated visuals and player accessibility for an enhanced gameplay experience.
 An improved upgrade system where players can now spend resources to become stronger. 
 Dash movement and Almalgams use have been split for greater accessibility.
 Language support for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with further enhancements to be added. 

Also, we are today launching a special game bundle on Steam. The ‘Alchemic Bundle’ contains two games - REMEDIUM and BattleJuice Alchemist and allows you to purchase both games with the 25% discount. That’s not all, as you can also buy the REMEDIUM game separately with 20% discount which will last for two weeks only!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41846/Alchemic_Bundle/

notes.title: Memory Lost: Chapter One Receives Huge Content Update!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a massive update to Memory Lost: Chapter One! You can now play the entire first chapter of the full game by heading to Memory Lost: Chapter One  and jumping straight into the fresh, updated gameplay and seeing what’s in store for the full launch next year!

[previewyoutube=rvGlwLCvWfc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Memory Lost: Chapter One  was first launched in December 2022 and has delighted shooter fans with its innovative combat mechanics and fast-paced gameplay. As part of the continued development journey of Memory Lost, we will continue to use the valuable feedback gathered from the Memory Lost: Chapter One to enhance the full game experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

notes.title: Major language update, Discount, and Second act release!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, today we have some great news that we want to share with you immediately!
First of all, we have prepared the biggest language update, which currently supports almost all languages the game will be available in. In addition, we continue to work on other localizations, improving those that have already been released earlier. Thus, REMEDIUM is now available with the following localizations:

 English
 French
 Italian
 German
 Spanish
 Portuguese
 Russian
 Polish
 Simplified Chinese
 Japanese
 Korean

And secondly, we are currently preparing a major game update and the imminent release of the second act of the game, scheduled for November 30! Moreover, the Steam Autumn Sale starts tomorrow, during which REMEDIUM can be purchased at a discount! This is probably the best opportunity to buy the game in anticipation of the release of the second act!

notes.title: Halloween Update Notes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! In honor of the already arrived Halloween, we have released another update for REMEDIUM, which includes a number of significant improvements and changes to the gameplay and the game's visuals! HAPPY HALLOWEEN, FRIENDS!

[olist]
 First appearance of skill progression in action!
 Added new enemy spawn mechanics
 Cosmetic lighting adjustments have been made (making this update quite BIG)
 Aggressive enemies are now highlighted
 Armor highlighting color has been adjusted to match the amalgam color
 Fixed issues with enemies getting stuck or clipping in geometry when jumping over chasms or from heights
 Fixed a bug with the triggering and non-triggering of the appearance of some enemies
 Light highlighting for the player's target has been added
 Light highlighting for destructible objects within a certain radius around the player has been added
[/olist]

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
Demo update!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone! We have improved and expanded REMEDIUM free demo!

More levels are now available and the average duration of the demo has tripled! It is also possibile to craft new weapons at the workbench, which gives even more depth to exploration and battles. notes.title: Game and demo update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

Thank you for playing the Remedium demo. We continue to read your feedback and work on various improvements. Today we decided to share with you what we have already managed to change and update in the game:

💡 Made the whole environment lighter and richer in colors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/c93aba59561cb983885cdc5d319c4068ad5e7360.jpg
Worked on the lights, now you can see where you're going.

👁 Removed the obscuring elements on the rooftops.
👁 Added readability to enemies by highlighting some elements.
👁 Changed the model of the protagonist, for more anatomy, taking into account the game camera.

📚 Added health and armor tutorial.

⚙️ Fixed alchemy ammo - now it falls from the minibosses, and switches by middle mouse button.
⚙️ Fixed restart - now after the death the player does not throw out to the main menu.
⚙️ Fixed the sound settings options.
